headline: The Golden Age May Be Over: The Government Is Thoroughly Meddling with the System
summary: Transport and Investment Minister Dávid Vitézy presented the government's new housing policy, covering rental housing, rust-belt redevelopment and priority investments. The priority-investment process has drawn criticism.
why: Government housing policy affects construction activity, property valuations and public investment. Changes to investment rules can shift developer and lender expectations.
